coverage_note: State, county, municipal, school district and other public employees under the New Jersey Employer-Employee Relations Act, N.J.S.A. 34:13A-1 et seq. Text is PERC's compilation of chapter 13A current as of March 31, 2022; amendments after that date were not checked.
quote_normalization: quote_binding exact-substring is checked after Unicode NFC and collapsing every run of whitespace (including no-break space) to one space, in both the quote and the text extracted from the captured bytes (HTML: BeautifulSoup get_text; PDF: pdftotext)
provenance_id_canonicalization: provenance_id = 'prov-' + sha256 of the record serialized as JSON with sorted keys, separators (',', ':'), UTF-8, without the provenance_id field; re-fingerprint with scripts/lib/provenance.mjs once P0 lands
disclaimer: Reference summary of public law, not legal advice. Members with a specific case should talk to a steward or a lawyer.

governing_statute.value: New Jersey Employer-Employee Relations Act, N.J.S.A. 34:13A-1 et seq.
governing_statute.quote: A majority representative of public employees in an appropriate unit shall be entitled to act for and to negotiate agreements covering all employees in the unit

ulp_limitation_period.value: Six months from the unfair practice to the filing of the charge, unless the charging party was prevented from filing
ulp_limitation_period.quote: provided that no complaint shall issue based upon any unfair practice occurring more than six months prior to the filing of the charge unless the person aggrieved thereby was prevented from filing such charge

who_may_bargain.value: Any person holding a position by appointment, contract or employment in the service of a public employer, except elected officials, members of boards and commissions, managerial executives and confidential employees
who_may_bargain.quote: This term shall include any public employee, i.e., any person holding a position, by appointment or contract, or employment in the service of a public employer, except elected officials, members of boards and commissions, managerial executives and confidential employees.

scope_of_bargaining.value: Terms and conditions of employment; proposed new rules or changes in rules governing working conditions must be negotiated with the majority representative
scope_of_bargaining.quote: Proposed new rules or modifications of existing rules governing working conditions shall be negotiated with the majority representative before they are established.

impasse_procedure.value: PERC mediation, then fact-finding with recommendations. Police and fire units go to binding conventional interest arbitration under 34:13A-16.
impasse_procedure.quote: In the event of a failure to resolve the impasse by mediation the Division of Public Employment Relations is empowered to recommend or invoke factfinding with recommendation for settlement, the cost of which shall be borne by the commission.

strike_legality.null_reason: The Act as captured protects only private employees' right to strike (34:13A-8) and does not address public-employee strikes; their status rests on court decisions, which were not captured.

agency_fee_status.value: Not collectible from nonconsenting public employees. The Act still provides for a representation fee in lieu of dues, but Janus v. AFSCME (2018) bars agency fees from nonconsenting public employees.
agency_fee_status.quote: negotiate concerning the subject of requiring the payment by all nonmember employees in the unit to the majority representative of a representation fee in lieu of dues for services rendered by the majority representative.
